ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I chose Willet because this query is a benign, structure-and-summarize task with no sensitive content, so the two models' shared flat preference for harm-adjacent material doesn't factor in. The deciding factor is capability: Willet scores meaningfully higher than Curlew on the dimensions that matter here — Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3), Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6), and across public benchmarks like MMLU-Pro and Arena-Hard — and those gaps exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold. For organizing factual content into a clear presentation, the more capable model is the better fit.
